description: Browser macro benchmarks against Chrome (stories/browser_macro.py, crossbench's model): Speedometer 3.1, MotionMark 1.3 and JetStream 2.2 from pinned local copies served on loopback with nothing else resolving, in a fresh cmux bench app's Chromium tab (debug.cef checked before and after) and in Chrome stable, interleaved ABBA over 2 rounds; each suite's per-iteration scores per arm and the per-round cmux/Chrome score ratio.
